pattern.description: A 3D knight piece carrying a cartoon rider charges across a static flat UI (course picker with stats bar), the rider tumbling off and both exiting frame, leaving the UI untouched.
pattern.why_premium: Mixes rendered 3D characters over flat product UI, adding personality and depth with motion blur and perspective scale while the product screen stays readable.

build_hint.gsap: Static UI layer underneath; knight sprite: gsap.fromTo(knight, {x: -200, scale: 0.8, rotate: -10}, {x: 900, scale: 2.2, rotate: 15, duration: 0.65, ease: 'power2.in'}); rider: timeline offset 0.05s, arc via motionPath up and over then down, rotate 360, duration 0.75, ease 'power1.inOut'; add a motion-blur filter during peak speed.
build_hint.remotion: Overlay two sprites over the UI; knight translateX/scale via interpolate(frame, [0, 20], ...) with Easing.in(Easing.quad); rider position on a parabolic arc from interpolate plus rotate; extrapolateRight clamp so both exit cleanly.

notes: Both moving elements leave the frame before the end frame, so b02/b01 are the diff/union areas of their paths rather than settled positions. The middle tile is occluded early and shows the French flag once the knight passes; it may have swapped under occlusion but cannot be confirmed, so it is not listed.
